summary: Knicks open their title defense at -4.5 against a rebuilt LeBron/Jaylen Brown Sixers team. Our efficiency projection is 227.6, under the 231.5 total. Most likely winner: K. Towns o6.5 rebounds.

extra_legs.note: Projection is NYK 115.4 + PHI 112.2 = 227.6, using the efficiency x possessions method, versus 231.5. Slow Knicks pace backs the under.
Champions bring back their whole starting five against a new-look Philly team with thin frontcourt depth.

research:
TOTALS (NBA.md method): average possessions = (NYK 96.8 + PHI 99.4)/2 = 98.1. NYK = avg(119.8 ORtg x 0.981 = 117.5, PHI 115.5 DRtg x 0.981 = 113.3) = 115.4. PHI = avg(115.4 x 0.981 = 113.2, NYK 113.3 DRtg x 0.981 = 111.1) = 112.2. Projected total 227.6 vs DK 231.5 (232-232.5 elsewhere); projected margin NYK +3.2 before home court. Source: Basketball-Reference 2025-26 team advanced stats. Caveat: PHI's offense should improve with LeBron and Brown, which is why the under is a lean rather than strong.
USAGE (2025-26, opening week, so last season's numbers): Brunson 30.4%, Towns 25.9%, Maxey 29.4%, Embiid 33.5% (38 games), Jaylen Brown 36.2% (BOS), LeBron 27.2% (LAL). Expect Maxey, Brown, LeBron and Embiid to cannibalize each other's usage; books cut Maxey to 21.5 and LeBron to 15.5 (DK).
DvP (RotoGrinders cheat sheet, FanDuel FPPG): PHI allowed C 55.3 (1st, most), PF 3rd, SG 4th, SF 7th, PG 10th. NYK: PG 14th, SG 17th, SF 23rd, PF 26th, C 23rd, so it is tough on every position.
HIT RATES (B-Ref 2025-26 game logs): Brunson 26.0/3.3/6.8 in 74 games: 12+ pts 95.9%, 20+ 79.7%, 1+ reb 94.6%, 3+ ast 95.9%, 7+ ast 54.1%. Towns 20.1/11.9/2.9 in 75 games: 10+ pts 93.3%, 7+ reb 93.3% (92.6% with playoffs), 10+ reb 78.7%, 1+ ast 100%.
PRICES: bet365 news ladders: Brunson 20+ -650, 25+ -190, 30+ +140; 7+ ast -120. Towns reb ladder 5/7/10/13 (garbled; read as -6600/-1400/-300/+120, matching the separate 13+ +120 quote); Towns 20+ pts +110. Embiid 20+ pts -225. FanDuel Research: Brunson o6.5 ast -118. SportsGambler: Brunson 26.5 -114/-120, Towns u18.5 pts -127 (BetMGM), Towns o11.5 reb -115. Game: DK NY -4.5, 231.5 (o-112/u-108), ML -180/+150; bet365 NY -4.5 -112, 232.5, ML -182/+152; Pinnacle Under 232 -106 via SBR.
INJURIES: PHI: Barlow OUT (lumbar bone stress, re-evaluated in 2 weeks), Tacko Fall OUT, Hukporti OUT (torn Achilles); Simons (hamstring, missed all preseason), Bona (foot; practiced fully Sunday) and Dean Wade (ankle) questionable. Embiid and LeBron are NOT listed (ClutchPoints, NBC Sports Philadelphia, Metro Philadelphia). NYK: no injuries listed.
ROSTERS/CHEMISTRY: PHI projected starters are Maxey, Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, LeBron, Embiid; LeBron (24th season) and Brown are new, so there is a chemistry ramp, and LeBron had limited preseason minutes. Frontcourt depth is very thin behind Embiid. NYK, the defending champs (53-29, 16-3 in the playoffs, Finals over SAS), return Brunson, Hart, Bridges, Anunoby and Towns; Mitchell Robinson left for BOS and Andre Drummond is the backup C; Clarkson, Alvarado, Shamet and Diawara are depth (ESPN, NBA.com previews).
COACHING: Mike Brown's Knicks played at the league's slowest-tier pace (96.8) with a top-5 offense (119.8). Nurse's PHI ran a league-average pace (99.4) and may go small with Barlow out. Banner night at MSG on NBC.
EXPERTS: Dimers has NYK 62.9-65.8% to win, projects 118-113 and sees value on PHI +4.5. SI, BettingPros and SBR take NYK -4.5; Pickswise takes PHI +4.5; TheLines takes PHI ML +150. SportsGambler and SBR lean Under 232/232.5. Props: Covers Brunson o26.5; BettingPros LeBron o30.5 PRA; SI Maxey o21.5; SBR LeBron u15.5 pts.
H2H: four regular-season meetings in 2025-26; NYK swept PHI 4-0 in the 2026 East semis (Brunson 35/26/33/22).
